data.name: Karin
data.long_meaning: The Norse name Karin means 'pure one' or 'dear one'. It is derived from the Old Norse word 'karr', which means 'dear' or 'pure'. In Norse mythology, the name Karin is associated with the goddess Freya, who is the goddess of love, fertility, and war.
